about.title: About
about.subtitle: A non-commercial project — we collect memories and photos
about.text: Sheregesh Hockey is a non-commercial project about the history of ice hockey in the village of Sheregesh. We collect memories, photos, and facts about teams, rinks, and tournaments from 1970–2000. If you have materials or stories — share them via «Share Your Story».

village.title: The Village
village.subtitle: The mine, the people, and hockey's place in village life
village.text: Sheregesh is a village in Tashtagol district, Kemerovo region, built around a mine. Hockey on natural ice and on a boarded rink was a central part of local life for years and brought miners and families together. Both backyard hockey and the mine team «Gornyak» played here.
village.locationText: Tashtagol district, Kemerovo region, Mountain Shoria
village.mineText: Sheregesh iron ore deposit, the economic backbone of the village
village.climateText: Winters down to −30°C, stable ice from November to March — perfect for hockey
village.populationText: ~2,500 people in the 1970s–1990s; miners and their families

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Gornyak and other teams
teams.text: The main team was «Gornyak» of the Sheregesh mine; other teams took part in district and inter-village tournaments in different years. Lineups and photos will be added as materials are received.
teams.gornyakText: The main team of the Sheregesh mine. Competed in district and inter-village tournaments in the Tashtagol area. The roster was drawn from mine workers.
teams.backyardText: Informal teams of schoolchildren and local youth. They played on natural ice in courtyards, schoolyards, and frozen ponds.

stories.title: Memories
stories.subtitle: Stories from those who played and cheered
stories.s1Text: My first skates came from my older brother, a miner. I went out on the ice by the mine with them.
stories.s2Text: When they put up the lights, they played late. I brought them tea in a thermos — my husband and his mates.
stories.s3Text: In 99 the veterans of the 70s and 80s got together for a symbolic game. For many it was the last time on ice.

rinks.title: Rinks & Venues
rinks.subtitle: Outdoor rinks and the boarded rink
rinks.text: They played on natural ice by the mine, then on the boarded rink with lights. Schoolyards were used for backyard hockey. Specific places and descriptions will be added over time.
rinks.mineRinkText: The main venue with boards and lighting. Home to Gornyak games and district tournaments.
rinks.schoolyardText: Backyard hockey venue. The ice was flooded each winter by parents and teachers.
rinks.centralText: Open-air rink in the village center for public skating and youth practice.
